title: Polymorphic Extended Crafting
description: Adds Polymorph compatibility to Extended Crafting mod.

Polymorphic Extended Crafting

An add-on mod providing [Polymorph](https://modrinth.com/mod/polymorph) support for the crafting tables from [Extended Crafting](https://modrinth.com/mod/extended-crafting), adding Polymorph's recipe selection button to the Basic, Advanced, Elite and Ultimate Crafting Tables in order to choose between conflicting crafting recipes instead of being forced to work with only one of these conflicting recipes. When a group of ingredients matches more than one recipe, a button will appear above the output slot. Clicking it shows a list of all possible results, selecting one changes the crafting output to match. Polymorph will remember the last selection as long as the ingredients don't change, allowing repeated crafting actions on the same selection. **Required mods:** [Extended Crafting](https://modrinth.com/mod/extended-crafting), and either [Polymorph](https://modrinth.com/mod/polymorph) or [Polymorph+](https://modrinth.com/mod/polymorph-plus). Polymorph+ is recommended for the extra QoL features (scrollable conflict list, pinnable selector panel, first-run tutorial overlay, Crafter recipe lock support).
